chip.description: Sprite controller of Twin Cobra, Wardner and Rally Bike: up to 512 fixed 16x16 sprites with flip, a 6-bit colour index and a 2-bit priority level.
chip.notes: src/mame/toaplan/toaplan_scu.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Toaplan Sprite Controller 'SCU'"). Not to be confused with the separate Toaplan 1 video controller that the Out Zone schematics also label SCU, which MAME keeps in toaplan_video_controller.cpp.
